narr-intro.text: High on Cloud Mountain stood a little castle made of clouds. And inside, someone was crying.
narr-intro.speaker: Narrator

smudge-cry.text: Boo hoo... Nobody ever wants to play with me.
smudge-cry.speaker: Pip

fairy-intro.text: It's the little purple dragon! He's shy. He's hiding in the clouds. Can you find him, Kathleen?
fairy-intro.speaker: Pip

fairy-found-3.text: Peekaboo! You're so good at this!
fairy-found-3.speaker: Pip

smudge-sorry.text: I'm Smudge. I took the magic keys, and I sneezed the colours away. I'm sorry. I just wanted a friend.
smudge-sorry.speaker: Pip

fairy-crown.text: Kathleen, let's make Smudge a friendship crown, with all the treasures we found!
fairy-crown.speaker: Pip

smudge-happy.text: A crown, for me? Thank you, Kathleen! Will you be my friend?
smudge-happy.speaker: Pip

fairy-friends.text: Of course we will! Friends forever!
fairy-friends.speaker: Pip

narr-rainbow.text: Smudge laughed for the very first time, and a big, beautiful rainbow came back across the sky.
narr-rainbow.speaker: Narrator

smudge-ride.text: Climb on! I'll fly you home!
smudge-ride.speaker: Pip

narr-end.text: And so Smudge flew Princess Kathleen and Pip all the way home. The End... of book one. But Smudge will be back for more adventures!
narr-end.speaker: Narrator
